subject.title: fix(ui): add empty sidebar drop targets

question: Should this maintainer-labeled Control UI follow-up proceed after its behind-base branch is refreshed against current main?
rationale: The implementation follows an already merged sidebar direction, but the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling rather than automated cleanup.

options.title: Refresh and land
options.body: Rebase onto current main, confirm the focused sidebar drag tests on the merge result, then merge the bounded follow-up.

options.title: Pause for broader UI review
options.body: Hold the PR only if current-main sidebar changes reveal a conflicting drag/drop interaction that needs a broader design decision.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land
